title: Comprehensive Deployment Data Schema with 30-Day Completeness Validation
description: Complete schema for validating deployment data with 30-day completeness requirements, structural validation, temporal validation, data quality validation, and completeness validation. This schema implements validation rules SV-001 through CV-004 as specified in the 30-day completeness validation specification.

metadata.description: Metadata section - Required for all deployment data files. Contains generation timestamps, data period coverage, source systems, and scope information. (Validation Rule: SV-002 - Metadata Structure)

generated_at.description: Timestamp when this deployment data was generated. Must be in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2026-08-06T09:30:00Z'). Used to validate data freshness and determine if data needs refresh. (Validation Rule: TV-002 - Timestamp Validity, TV-003 - Timestamp Consistency)

data_period_start.description: Start of the 30-day analysis window in ISO 8601 format. Defines the beginning of the coverage period for completeness validation. Must be at least 28 days before data_period_end. (Validation Rule: TV-001 - 30-Day Coverage, TV-003 - Timestamp Consistency)

data_period_end.description: End of the 30-day analysis window in ISO 8601 format. Defines the coverage period boundary. Must be before or equal to generated_at. (Validation Rule: TV-001 - 30-Day Coverage, TV-003 - Timestamp Consistency)

services.description: List of services covered in this deployment data. Must include at least one service. For whisper-stt validation, must contain 'whisper-stt'. Used to scope validation to specific services. (Validation Rule: SV-002 - Metadata Structure)

contains.description: Must contain whisper-stt service for 30-day completeness validation

clusters.description: List of Kubernetes clusters queried for deployment data. Each cluster should be accessible and contain the deployment history. Must include at least one cluster. (Validation Rule: SV-002 - Metadata Structure)

data_sources.description: Data sources used to compile deployment information. Each source contributes different aspects of deployment data. At least one source required. (Validation Rule: SV-002 - Metadata Structure)

enumDescriptions.kubernetes_replicasets: ReplicaSet history from Kubernetes API - provides deployment timestamps, images, and replica counts
enumDescriptions.argo_workflows: CI/CD pipeline execution data from Argo Workflows - provides build timestamps and pipeline success/failure
enumDescriptions.argo_cd: Application sync and health status from ArgoCD - provides current deployment state and sync status
enumDescriptions.git_history: Git commit history - provides deployment commits and change metadata
enumDescriptions.pod_monitoring: Pod health and runtime metrics - provides current pod status and resource usage

argo_workflows.description: Argo Workflows section - Optional but recommended. Contains CI/CD pipeline execution data for build workflows. Provides deployment pipeline success rates and build timestamps. (Validation Rule: SV-001 - Top-Level Structure - optional section)

whisper_stt_build.description: whisper-stt build workflow template and execution data. Contains template metadata and run history. Optional if no Argo Workflows are configured.

template_name.description: Name of the Argo WorkflowTemplate used for whisper-stt builds. Identifies the pipeline template in the Argo Workflows system.

template_created.description: Timestamp when the workflow template was created. Used to track pipeline configuration age and changes.

workflow_runs_last_30_days.description: Total number of workflow runs in the 30-day period. Indicates CI/CD activity level. Zero may indicate manual deployments or missing data.

workflow_runs.description: Detailed list of workflow runs with timestamps, status, and duration. Provides execution history for success/failure analysis.

workflow_name.description: Unique name of this workflow run instance

started_at.description: Workflow start timestamp in ISO 8601 format

finished_at.description: Workflow completion timestamp in ISO 8601 format

status.description: Final workflow execution status. Succeeded indicates successful build, Failed/Error indicate build failures.

duration_seconds.description: Workflow execution duration in seconds. Used for performance analysis and trend detection.

argo_cd.description: ArgoCD section - Optional but recommended. Contains ArgoCD application deployment state, sync status, and health information. Provides current GitOps deployment state. (Validation Rule: SV-001 - Top-Level Structure - optional section)

whisper-stt.description: ArgoCD applications for whisper-stt service. Contains application discovery and status information. Optional if ArgoCD is not used for this service.

application_found.description: Whether whisper-stt ArgoCD application was found in the cluster. False indicates manual deployment or missing ArgoCD configuration.

applications.description: List of ArgoCD applications for whisper-stt. Empty array if application_found is false. Populated with application details if found.

namespace.description: Kubernetes namespace where the application is deployed

project.description: ArgoCD project name for grouping applications

sync_status.description: ArgoCD sync status indicates if deployed resources match Git repository. Synced is desired state.

enumDescriptions.Synced: Application is in sync with Git repository
enumDescriptions.Unknown: Sync status could not be determined

health_status.description: ArgoCD health status indicates application operational state. Healthy is desired state.

enumDescriptions.Progressing: Application is transitioning to a new state
enumDescriptions.Unknown: Health status could not be determined

cluster_deployments.description: Cluster Deployments section - Required. Contains Kubernetes deployment data from ReplicaSet analysis. This is the primary data source for 30-day completeness validation. (Validation Rule: SV-001, SV-003 - Service-Specific Structure)

whisper-stt.description: whisper-stt deployment information. Contains deployment metadata, replica history, and version information. Required for 30-day completeness validation. (Validation Rule: SV-003 - Service-Specific Structure, DQ-001 - Required Fields Presence)

namespace.description: Kubernetes namespace where whisper-stt is deployed. Critical field for cluster resource identification. (Validation Rule: DQ-001 - Required Fields Presence)

deployment_name.description: Kubernetes deployment resource name. Critical field for deployment tracking. (Validation Rule: DQ-001 - Required Fields Presence)

created_at.description: Initial deployment creation timestamp. Indicates when the service was first deployed to the cluster.

current_image.description: Current container image in use. Must match pattern registry/name:tag. Critical field for version tracking. (Validation Rule: DQ-001 - Required Fields Presence)

current_replicas.description: Current number of running replicas for this deployment. Must be non-negative. (Validation Rule: DQ-002 - Numeric Field Ranges)

last_updated.description: Most recent deployment update timestamp. Used to determine deployment freshness and activity.

replica_history.description: Historical ReplicaSet data for the 30-day period. Primary data source for completeness validation. Contains all deployment attempts with timestamps, images, and outcomes. (Validation Rule: CV-001 - Minimum Deployment Days, CV-002 - Gap Detection, CV-003 - Replica History Completeness)

name.description: ReplicaSet name identifier. Kubernetes-generated name with unique hash suffix.

created_at.description: ReplicaSet creation timestamp. Critical for temporal analysis and gap detection. Must be within 30-day window for completeness. (Validation Rule: TV-001 - 30-Day Coverage)

image.description: Container image used in this ReplicaSet. Must match registry/name:tag pattern.

replicas.description: Number of replicas requested for this ReplicaSet. Must be non-negative. (Validation Rule: DQ-002 - Numeric Field Ranges)

available_replicas.description: Number of available replicas for this ReplicaSet. Null if scaled down to zero. Must be non-negative if not null.

ready_replicas.description: Number of ready replicas for this ReplicaSet. Null if scaled down to zero. Must be non-negative if not null.

status.description: ReplicaSet deployment outcome. Used for success/failure analysis and deployment reliability metrics. (Validation Rule: DQ-003 - Enum Field Validity)

enumDescriptions.successful: ReplicaSet deployed successfully and is running
enumDescriptions.rolled_over: ReplicaSet was replaced by a newer deployment
enumDescriptions.scaled_down_or_failed: ReplicaSet failed or was scaled down

days_ago.description: Days since this ReplicaSet was created, relative to data generation time. Value of 0 means created today, 30 means created 30 days ago. Used for temporal analysis and coverage calculation. (Validation Rule: TV-001 - 30-Day Coverage)

replica_history.minItemsDescription: Minimum 5 replica history entries required for 30-day completeness validation. Fewer entries indicate insufficient deployment activity or missing data. (Validation Rule: CV-001 - Minimum Deployment Days: requires 5 distinct deployment days)

deployments_last_30_days.description: Total number of deployments in the 30-day period. Includes successful, failed, and rolled-over deployments. Must be non-negative. (Validation Rule: DQ-002 - Numeric Field Ranges, CV-004 - Summary Metrics Consistency)

successful_deployments.description: Number of successful deployments in the 30-day period. Deployments with status 'successful' or 'rolled_over'. Must be non-negative. (Validation Rule: DQ-002 - Numeric Field Ranges)

failed_deployments.description: Number of failed or scaled-down deployments in the 30-day period. Deployments with status 'failed' or 'scaled_down_or_failed'. Must be non-negative. (Validation Rule: DQ-002 - Numeric Field Ranges)

deployment_versions.description: List of image versions deployed in the 30-day period. Each version must match semantic version pattern. Used to track version churn and rollout patterns. (Validation Rule: DQ-003 - Enum/Pattern Field Validity)
deployment_versions.minItemsDescription: At least one deployment version must be present in the 30-day period.

all_versions_in_history.description: Complete list of all versions ever deployed for this service. Includes versions outside the 30-day window. Provides deployment history context. Each version must match semantic version pattern.
all_versions_in_history.minItemsDescription: At least one version must be present in complete deployment history.

summary.description: Summary section - Required. Contains aggregated statistics for the 30-day deployment period. Provides high-level metrics and coverage indicators. (Validation Rule: SV-001, CV-004 - Summary Metrics Consistency)

total_deployments_last_30_days.description: Total deployments across all services in the 30-day period. Must match cluster_deployments totals. (Validation Rule: CV-004 - Summary Metrics Consistency, DQ-002 - Numeric Field Ranges)

whisper_stt_deployments.description: Number of whisper-stt deployments in the 30-day period. Must be non-negative. (Validation Rule: DQ-002 - Numeric Field Ranges)

successful_deployments.description: Number of successful deployments across all services. Must be non-negative. (Validation Rule: DQ-002 - Numeric Field Ranges)

failed_or_scaled_down.description: Number of failed or scaled-down deployments across all services. Must be non-negative. (Validation Rule: DQ-002 - Numeric Field Ranges)

data_coverage.description: Percentage of data coverage in the 30-day period. Calculated as (days_covered / 30) * 100. Values below 93% (28/30) indicate insufficient coverage. (Validation Rule: TV-001 - 30-Day Coverage)

gaps_detected.description: Whether data gaps were detected in the 30-day period. True indicates missing deployment days, false indicates continuous coverage. Critical for completeness validation. (Validation Rule: CV-002 - Gap Detection, CV-004 - Summary Metrics Consistency)

largest_gap_days.description: Size of the largest gap in days. Value of 0 means no gaps. Values >= 14 indicate critical coverage issues. (Validation Rule: CV-002 - Gap Detection)

pod_health.description: Pod Health section - Optional but recommended. Contains current pod status and runtime metrics. Provides operational health snapshot. (Validation Rule: SV-001 - Top-Level Structure - optional section)

current_pods.description: List of currently running pods with detailed status. Used for operational monitoring and troubleshooting.

age_days.description: Pod age in days since creation

totalRestartCount.description: Total restarts across all containers in the pod

node.description: Node where the pod is running

pod_metrics.description: Aggregate pod health metrics across all pods

total_containers.description: Total number of containers across all pods

resources.description: Resources section - Optional. Contains CPU and memory allocation and limits for the deployment. Used for capacity planning and resource analysis.

cpu.patternDescription: CPU format: cores (e.g., '1') or millicores (e.g., '100m' = 0.1 cores)

storage.description: Storage section - Optional. Contains PVC and volume information for persistent storage. Used for capacity planning and storage analysis.

age_days.description: Storage age in days since creation

error_incidents.description: Error Incidents section - Optional. Contains error incidents and failures recorded during the 30-day period. Used for reliability analysis and failure pattern detection.

total_incidents.description: Total number of error incidents recorded

incident_details.description: Detailed incident reports with timestamps, severity, and resolution

notes.description: Notes section - Optional. Contains additional observations, context, and analysis notes about the deployment data. Used to document findings and provide context.

items.description: Individual note string with observation or context

thirtyDayCoverage.description: Validation definition for 30-day data completeness requirements. Ensures deployment data spans sufficient time for operational analysis.

largest_gap_days.description: Size of largest gap in days

validationRules.description: Complete validation rule catalog with IDs and descriptions

SV-001.name: Top-Level Structure
SV-001.description: Validates presence of required top-level sections (metadata, cluster_deployments, summary)
SV-001.impact: Deployment data is incomplete without required sections

SV-002.name: Metadata Structure
SV-002.description: Validates metadata field presence, types, and non-empty array requirements
SV-002.impact: Cannot validate data period or scope without complete metadata

SV-003.name: Service-Specific Structure
SV-003.description: Validates service deployment data structure and required fields
SV-003.impact: Cannot perform completeness analysis without service data

TV-001.name: 30-Day Coverage
TV-001.description: Validates deployment data covers minimum 28 days (recommended 30) within analysis period. Checks replica_history timestamps span sufficient time for analysis.
TV-001.severity: CRITICAL if < 28 days, WARNING if < 30 days
TV-001.impact: Insufficient data for trend analysis and pattern detection

TV-002.name: Timestamp Validity
TV-002.description: Validates all timestamp fields are in ISO 8601 format, not in the future, and not unreasonably old
TV-002.impact: Cannot perform temporal analysis with invalid timestamps

TV-003.name: Timestamp Consistency
TV-003.description: Validates timestamp relationships: start < end, end <= generated_at
TV-003.impact: Inconsistent timestamps indicate data generation errors

DQ-001.name: Required Fields Presence
DQ-001.description: Validates critical fields are present and non-null: namespace, deployment_name, current_image, replica_history
DQ-001.impact: Missing critical fields prevents deployment analysis

DQ-002.name: Numeric Field Ranges
DQ-002.description: Validates numeric fields are non-negative and aggregate consistency (successful + failed <= total)
DQ-002.impact: Invalid numeric values indicate data corruption

DQ-003.name: Enum Field Validity
DQ-003.description: Validates status fields contain only allowed enum values
DQ-003.impact: Invalid status values may indicate data collection errors

CV-001.name: Minimum Deployment Days
CV-001.description: Validates minimum 5 distinct deployment days (recommended 10) in replica_history. Ensures sufficient deployment activity for analysis.
CV-001.severity: CRITICAL if < 5 days, WARNING if < 10 days
CV-001.impact: Insufficient deployment activity for reliability analysis

CV-002.name: Gap Detection
CV-002.description: Detects significant gaps between consecutive deployments (>= 7 days warning, >= 14 days critical). Identifies missing deployment data or service inactivity.
CV-002.severity: WARNING if gap >= 7 days, CRITICAL if gap >= 14 days
CV-002.impact: Gaps indicate missing data or service downtime affecting analysis completeness

CV-003.name: Replica History Completeness
CV-003.description: Validates replica_history is not empty and contains sufficient records for 30-day analysis
CV-003.impact: Empty replica history prevents all deployment analysis

CV-004.name: Summary Metrics Consistency
CV-004.description: Validates summary metrics match cluster deployment data: total_deployments_last_30_days, gaps_detected consistency
CV-004.impact: Inconsistent summary metrics indicate data aggregation errors

CSV-001.name: Data Period Alignment
CSV-001.description: Validates all services use the same global data period for multi-service comparison

CSV-002.name: Multi-Service Comparison
CSV-002.description: Validates data structure supports multiple services for comparative analysis
CSV-002.impact: Single-service data cannot be compared across services
